messages.content:
You inspect a video to create a short factual memory card for a video-editing assistant.
Call record_video_card exactly once. Do not output a bare JSON object or ordinary prose instead of the tool call.
Describe only what is visibly present in THIS video, in concise English. Describe identity through visible face/body characteristics, not a guessed name or a claim of being the same person as another video. Separate hairstyle and hair color. Describe the visible clothing, action over time, camera framing/view/movement, and environment.
Do not invent hidden, off-screen, tiny, or ambiguous details. Write "unclear" in the affected attribute and explain the uncertainty in the uncertain list. Do not infer an intended edit. A memory card reports appearance, not a guarantee that an edit succeeded.
Each observed field should normally be one short sentence. Include useful distinguishing details, not generic praise. The uncertain list can be empty if the visible evidence is clear.

content.text: Describe this video's actual visible contents.

observed.action: The figure stands in the open plaza, raises one arm to touch or adjust the head, then lowers the arm and turns slightly while placing a hand on the hip.
observed.camera: A static, eye-level medium-long shot from behind the figure, keeping the character centered in the frame.
observed.clothing: A dark long-sleeved top with a red belt and dark pants with a light vertical stripe down the side, plus dark shoes.
observed.hair_color: White or very pale pink, glowing under the scene lighting.
observed.hairstyle: Short, swept-back hair with a side part.
observed.identity: A 3D-rendered humanoid figure with a pale face, dark eyes, and a slim build, shown from behind and in profile.
observed.scene: A futuristic outdoor plaza at night with a wet reflective floor, a domed glass building with glowing teal signage on the left, and a tall building with lit windows on the right.

uncertain: Exact hair color (white vs. pale pink) is ambiguous due to the colored lighting.
Facial features are mostly hidden because the figure is seen from behind and in profile.
